sentences: Put {£1,000|a thousand pounds} in Premium Bonds for a year, and there's a {56%|fifty six per cent} chance you win nothing.
People say Premium Bonds pay {4.35%,|four point three five per cent,} beating savings.
But that's an average, lifted by two {£1 million|one million pound} jackpots a month.
Without prizes of {£1,000|a thousand pounds} and up, they pay about {3.7%.|three point seven per cent.}
That's below {NS&I's|N S and I's} own Direct Saver, at {3.75%.|three point seven five per cent.}
The catch: prizes are tax free, interest isn't.
Pay {40%|forty per cent} tax on your interest, and {3.75%|three point seven five per cent} becomes {2.25%.|two point two five per cent.}
